# External → intracellular CBD dose mapping

Runs ingested: run_20260422_173323, run_20260421_204933

Method: per (Age, pH) bin, fit Hill of Neuron_Health vs CBD_intracellular_final → EC50_intra; 
fit transfer function CBD_intracellular_final = f(CBD_extracellular_final); invert at EC50_intra and EC90_intra.


## Per (Age, pH) results

**Therapeutic intracellular window** is defined as [EC50_intra, EC90_intra] of the Hill fit of `Neuron_Health_final` vs `CBD_intracellular_final`.

**Administered dose** is the set `CBD_extracellular` initial concentration (condition-name parameter). Transfer fit `CBD_intracellular_final = f(set_dose)` is inverted to give the dose required to reach each intracellular target.
